doors.when: A remote MCP client such as Claude or ChatGPT calling Desk's tools for its signed-in account over streamable HTTP

errors.means: The gateway is not set up (its GitHub App settings are missing), so signed-in requests get JSON-RPC error -32000 with this in error.data.code.
errors.fix: Ask the gateway's operator to finish its setup and redeploy; retrying will not help until then.

errors.means: The JSON-RPC request body is over 4 MB; the x-desk-error-code header carries this.
errors.fix: Send a smaller request, such as fewer files in one desk_save.

errors.means: The request body is not valid JSON; the x-desk-error-code header carries this.

doors.when: The person's browser submitting the sign-in approval form during an OAuth authorization for a client

errors.means: The gateway is not set up, so a 503 page with the x-desk-error-code header answers instead of the form handler.
errors.fix: Sign-in works once the gateway's operator finishes its setup; then start again from the client.

errors.means: The form body is over 16 KB; the x-desk-error-code header carries this.
errors.fix: Start the sign-in again from the client.
